author: Murphh
body:
Today, I was playing TDM on a map where the other team was spawn killing.  I told them to stop. Xtra was there and he told them to stop too.

As part of the discussion, I said that spawn is off limits and they can't come in there at all. Zeusy said that it was okay to go in once I came out.. Spawn killing is spawn killing.  I'm in spawn getting killed. I checked the rules and I don't see it written anywhere that once you leave spawn, anyone can come back into spawn with you and kill you.

So Zeusy says, "6 months of playtime yet ignorant as fuck"..Wasn't he a mod before?  This really surprised me that he would make a comment directed at me like that.

Then I type, "Zeusy be respectful".

And Xtra types, "^". Then nothing more was said or done.

Zeusy broke a few of the general etiquette and behavior rules Be respectful of all players.Insulting is not allowed.He should be punished for un-sportsman like behavior.

title: Zeusy - rude comment

replies.author: TooSweetSki
replies.body:
...spawn killing. This is defined as killing players of other teams briefly after their spawning...  - avicus.net/rules

It is only considered spawn killing if you kill someone who has just spawned.
If you have already spawned and run back into your spawn area, your opposition are allowed to kill you, as you have not recently spawned.

I understand this is not defined well in the rules and will ask the Seniors to make an amendment so that the definition of spawn killing is more clear.

As for Zeus, yes, he shouldn't have said what he said, however, I assume this type of behaviour did not continue?

We generally do not issue infractions for something only said once (unless it was extreme)
Considering Zeus did not continue, Xtra was right to back up your verbal warning to Zeus.
He was also right in not issuing an infraction, because an infraction was not needed in this case.

This report has been denied, but I'll leave it open in case you have any questions.
Thanks.

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body:
Well, then I think the configuration of that particular spawn needs to be revised on Vallis. There are two choke points where the other players just sit and wait for you to exit spawn so they can kill you.  I would run back inside to avoid the 1 v 5 situation.  There is a back exit, but players were up there too. In fact, players, including Zeusy were running along the top of spawn waiting for players to exit, so they could pounce on the players exiting spawn.

That is not supportive of fun game play, to say the least.

As for Zeusy's comment, I feel he was/is getting special privilege due to his avicus status and xtra wouldn't have said anything or reacted, if I hadn't said anything.  Doing the "^" carrot thing is not a proper response by a mod.  I have seen many players get punished for far less in-game when only said once.

Your staff needs to get together to discuss consistencies and favoritism.  I'm really disappointed in your decision.

replies.author: TooSweetSki
replies.body:
It is not favouritism just because it doesn't go your way.

My decision was made unbiasedly.
I analysed the evidence and made a decision.
That decision is, there is not enough evidence to warrant a valid infraction.

If you have any evidence of Zeusy or anyone else camping spawn, spawn killing, please feel free to post it here.

Xtra did everything he was supposed to do in that situation, and I support him fully. 

If you have have a problem with a map's layout and configuration, contact a Map Developer.
I don't work with maps so I can't help you much there unfortunately.

But yes, please post that spawn killing evidence on this thread if you have any.
